sources.summary: Autonomous CI/CD for AI-written code: plans, builds, and adversarially audits changes to any repo — a different model reviews the builder — shipping only what passes deterministic gates. Failures become durable lessons; runs are checkpoint-resumable & context-optimized. Claude Code · Codex · Gemini.
